hypothesis: A shared original-F0 identity geometry with a bounded contribution-conditioned residual and learned pair relation can improve membership without damaging original known-class decisions.

adapter.input: same-pass four native contributions, ordered time_frequency/PA/reference/signature, 4x160
adapter.relation_input: concatenated absolute difference and elementwise product of unit160 query/support prototype

loss.slot_schedule: cycle evenly, all slots are original six visible L classes
loss.source_domain_grid: five public source RX x three source days, 15 cells
loss.L_support_sampling: each of six visible TX: one record per 15 cells plus one extra from a step-rotated cell; 16 per TX
loss.L_query_sampling: same 16-per-TX domain schedule, opaque IDs disjoint from all support IDs
loss.OE_sampling: four records per 15 public cells plus four extras in step-rotated distinct cells; no TX/K used
loss.support_prototype_per_query: unit mean over support of each visible old TX with different RX AND day from that query
loss.episode_membership_loss: BCEWithLogits(max relation over pseudo-known support classes), equal mean weight to pseudo-known and pseudo-unknown L queries
loss.OE_membership_loss: BCEWithLogits(max relation over full six old-class support prototypes), target zero
loss.soft_neighbor_L_rows: union of disjoint support and query, 192 rows
loss.soft_neighbor_candidate_base_weight: inverse eligible count in candidate RX/day cell, inside both teacher and student softmax
loss.soft_neighbor_anchor_average: equal per nonempty anchor RX/day cell, then half L plus half OE
loss.soft_neighbor_semantic_claim: soft geometric targets only; no unknown pseudo TX/K or pair hard labels

deployment_support.source: frozen source L only, visible old labels and public RX/day
deployment_support.state: six visible classes x fifteen source domains feature sums and counts, no retained physical rows
deployment_support.query_prototype: normalize(sum over source cells with RX different AND day different from the public query metadata)

implementation_verification.scope: synthetic native-contract and cached-source tensors only
implementation_verification.loss_tests: 8 passed in 4.63s; dtype-specific targeted recheck 1 passed in 3.80s, overlapping test not additional coverage

first_experiment_scope: source-only single-seed two-arm falsification; all preregistered source views predicted and frozen before independent scoring

promotion.if_not_pass: preserve/report both arms, no target access or multi-seed/formal expansion
promotion.if_pass: independently preregister one cross-RX G10 development evaluation; source success alone never certifies target
